---
title: Errors and troubleshooting
---

## Errors

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `ValueError` | A value breaks a rule of the protocol, true for every Sign: a bad File Label or Sign Address, a size or Run Time out of range, text that is not printable ASCII, STRING File content that is too long or holds a Control Code it can't. Raised when the value is built, before anything is sent. |
| `MarkupError` | Markup can't be read. A `ValueError`; `.position` is the offset of the problem. |
| `UnsupportedCapability` | With `strict=True`: the Sign Model lacks something the content uses, or a Memory Configuration is too big for it. Nothing is sent. |
| `UnsupportedCapabilityWarning` | The same problems without `strict`. The Packet is sent anyway. |
| `SignTimeoutError` | A read got no complete answer within `read_timeout`. A `TimeoutError`. |
| `ResponseError` | An answer is damaged, fails its Checksum, or can't be parsed. A `ValueError`. |
| `UnexpectedResponseError` | An answer belongs to a different read, and no other read is waiting for one. A `ResponseError`. |

Errors from the serial port itself, such as a port that can't be opened, are
pyserial's `serial.SerialException`. The library does not retry or reconnect.

## Common problems

### Nothing changes on the display

Check, in order:

1. The line settings: 9600 baud, 8N1 unless the Sign is set otherwise.
2. The Sign Type. A `model` addresses only that Sign Type; try `models.GENERIC`,
   which reaches every Sign.
3. The Sign Address. Address 0 reaches every Sign; another address reaches only the
   Sign set to it. `discover` lists the Signs and their addresses.
4. `sign.serial_errors()`, if reads work: a framing error usually means the baud
   rate is wrong.

### Reads raise `ValueError` about Sign Address 0

Reads need one Sign. Set
`address=` to the Sign's address, or pass `broadcast_reads=True` when it is the only
Sign on the line. See [Reading back and discovery](07-reading-and-discovery.qmd).

### Reads time out, but writes work

The Sign may not be the address you gave, or
the cable may not carry data back from the Sign.

### My Files are gone

`configure_memory` and `clear_memory` erase every File.

### A STRING File went blank

On a 4120C, a write longer than the File's size
empties it. Make the File bigger in the Memory Configuration.

### The end of a TEXT File's Message is missing

The Message is longer than the
File. A 4120C keeps what fits and records a buffer overflow.

### A big font shows small

On a two-line Sign, fonts taller than 7 rows show at
full height only in `Position.MIDDLE`.

### `beep` or `tone` makes no sound

The speaker is off at power-up; call
`sign.set_speaker(True)`.

### The time or date is wrong

The Sign shows its own clock. Set it with
`sign.set_clock(datetime.now())`.

### The library warns about content that works

The manual's tables have gaps.
Filter `UnsupportedCapabilityWarning`, or copy the profile and add the Capability
(see [Sign Models and validation](08-sign-models.qmd)), and please report it.
